WHO will leave #HalloweenHavoc as #WWENXT Champion when @GraysonWWE defends against @TonyDangeloWWE! 🔥

📺 7 ET/4 PT on @TheCW https://t.co/l80ucGcdky

transcript.text: Hey, hey, WWE, Grayson Waller has a live microphone finally. Hey, Tony D, why don't you come do something?
You finally got a chance to show the world what you can do because there was no one left. The NXT male roster is soft.
I'm gonna walk in, take the title, take the division, because unfortunately, I'm starting to remember who Grayson Waller is.
Fatal 4-way for the NXT title. I think the Grayson Waller effect.
Were you guys expecting someone else to win on Sunday? Well, I'm not surprised.
But this is just the beginning. Winning this title doesn't mean a thing unless I do something about it.
So who is gonna be the one to step up and knock me off my pedestal? Hold on a second.
I held this division together with my bare hands and I'm not gonna let you disrespect that title.
See, you never had the balls to face me one on one. I want my rematch.
Coming back here, I always knew it was gonna end up me and you. We got signs of WWE at about the same time.
We debuted on TV about the same time. We're even teammates in war games.
I did resent you and the truth is, I still do. That made me hungrier, that made me tougher and that made me champion.
All I have to do at Halloween Havoc is take you out in the deepest waters and let you drown yourself.
You walk around here and you talk like you're so big and bad.
At Halloween Havoc, I'm gonna see if you can swim in deep waters when there's a shark out there.
This is your house, Tony. You're a shark, lad. You ain't a shark.
I wonder if anyone's home.
And I needed you to know that I am always one step ahead.
You crossed the line. Where are you?
I told you I've been waiting a long time for this.
You stay right there. I'm coming to beat your ass.
There isn't anyone on any brand who can touch me on the run I'm doing right now.
That's a pissed off number one contender.
Grayson, Tony tearing each other apart.
The past is the present between these two.
Two's gonna walk out NXT champion.
